text_block_list.name: @Race_daisuki
text_block_list.text:
"—Today's Japan Cup prediction! TM Opera O 
is definitely taking it again!"

text_block_list.name: @love_dotou
text_block_list.text:
“I'm rooting for you, Doto-chan. Please be 
a worthy rival to Opera O.”

text_block_list.name: @kassoubot__
text_block_list.text:
“Generational change! Air Shakur is 
definitely gonna settle it.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Public interest in today's Japan Cup was 
remarkably high, with social media trends 
completely dominated by the race. Many 
voices were filled with anticipation for 
Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, what bothers me is—
choice_data_list:
(Her physical data really hasn't been 
updated.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The app Air Shakur installed on my 
smartphone syncs with my body composition 
scale and other gadgets to send updated 
records.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Watching that allowed me to closely check 
the daily changes in her physical data... 
but recently, the updates had stopped."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I realized, I went to confirm 
it with her, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I changed the measurement device. Once 
the Japan Cup is over, I'll update it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm checking it myself right now. You just 
focus on your paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tone left no room for argument, so I 
chose to trust her and held my tongue, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After changing into his racewear, Air 
Shakur looked somewhat frail and 
unreliant.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"We didn't hit the theoretical value for 
victory, but it's within expectations. 
That number was ridiculous anyway."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, I managed to reach a point where I 
won't get completely blown out. I made it 
this far. Everything's fine...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—No, should I review the runners' data 
one last time? The best-case scenario to 
place on the board would be..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? What, you're annoying.
choice_data_list:
Are you... talking like you're already 
going to lose?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was sensitive before the Nippon Derby 
too, but this time feels different. 
There's a different, darker presence 
lurking inside her—
choice_data_list: (How pathetic of me not to notice!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All we can do now is pray. Pray that she 
can shake off that darkness...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Shakur-san. To our theater!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-Welcome~...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Our"? Ha, sounds just like the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't recall being invited. I just 
barged right in.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's what I thought too, but... It 
seems right now, Shakur-san is being 
treated as a guest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Can an actor who has lost their fighting 
spirit truly step onto the stage?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved brilliant results, she 
comes charging in as the representative of 
our generation. And there I am, gracefully 
slipping past Shakur-san's fierce 
pursuit...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems we can't expect that kind of 
dramatic turn of events. For now, that 
role belongs to—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the rest to you as always, 
Dotou.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even so, Shakur-san is an 
amazing person too...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's incredibly smart, always thinking of 
ways to win...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san! Let's... um, have a great 
race today!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No. Doto... I'm... different from you 
guys.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The data already proves it... I know I 
won't reach 'em. So what the hell am I 
supposed to do about it!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Fate has already changed."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if we're only going to end up in 
one place in the end..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! Don't you chicken out. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I've got any choice but to 
go...!
